## what is tahini?


Tahini is a creamy, nutritious paste made from ground sesame seeds, an ingredient that dates back
thousands of years to ancient Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisines. Traditionally used in
dishes like hummus, baba ghanoush, and halva, tahini has become a pantry staple around the world for
its rich, nutty flavor and silky texture.

[LEARN MORE][50]

## the secret is in the seeds

**We source the highest quality sesame seeds to create a mildly nutty, silky-smooth tahini that's
easy to mix!**

[Soom tahini jars on a colorful tile background with lemons and chickpeas.]

### silky-smooth

We source seeds with a high oil-to-meat ratio and blend them to perfection using age old techniques.
The result is a silky-smooth consistency that can't be beat!

### easy to mix

Because of our premium seeds and special grinding process, Soom tahini separates less than the
others. If you do need to mix, it's quick and easy, unlike those other rock hard brands.

### mild nutty flavor

High quality seeds that are roasted at the right temperatures result in tahini that is mildly nutty
and not overly bitter. Soom tahini brings balance and flavor to any dish!

[
][51]

### big flavor for everyday meals, in one easy squeeze

Tahini has never been this easy, or this flavorful. Made from real, simple ingredients, Soom squeeze
bottles deliver smooth tahini and bold, globally-inspired flavors in one effortless drizzle.

No stirring, no prep, less mess. Just shake, squeeze, and drizzle for faster meals, finished dishes,
and silky sauces in seconds.

## what is tahini?


Tahini is a creamy, nutritious paste made from ground sesame seeds, an ingredient that dates back
thousands of years to ancient Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisines. Traditionally used in
dishes like hummus, baba ghanoush, and halva, tahini has become a pantry staple around the world for
its rich, nutty flavor and silky texture.

[LEARN MORE][50]

## the secret is in the seeds

**We source the highest quality sesame seeds to create a mildly nutty, silky-smooth tahini that's
easy to mix!**

[Soom tahini jars on a colorful tile background with lemons and chickpeas.]

### silky-smooth

We source seeds with a high oil-to-meat ratio and blend them to perfection using age old techniques.
The result is a silky-smooth consistency that can't be beat!

### easy to mix

Because of our premium seeds and special grinding process, Soom tahini separates less than the
others. If you do need to mix, it's quick and easy, unlike those other rock hard brands.

### mild nutty flavor

High quality seeds that are roasted at the right temperatures result in tahini that is mildly nutty
and not overly bitter. Soom tahini brings balance and flavor to any dish!

No stirring, no prep, less mess. Just shake, squeeze, and drizzle for faster meals, finished dishes,

## What is Tahini?

Tahini is a creamy paste made from ground sesame seeds, used for over 4,000 years in Mediterranean
and Middle Eastern cuisine. With 17g of protein and 426mg of calcium per 100g serving, tahini
delivers plant-based nutrition that rivals dairy while adding rich, nutty flavor to any dish.

From morning smoothies to dinner marinades, tahini is the superfood your pantry has been missing.

## What makes Humera Tahini unique?

[White sesame seeds]

Humera sesame from Tigray (Ethiopia) thrives in a sunny microclimate with well-drained, fertile
soils. This yields seeds with a high oil content and a mild, lightly nutty, subtly sweet flavor –
without bitterness. The result is a creamy tahini that needs no flavor adjustments.

[Krotaj factory premium tahini ethiopia]

with a pleasant mouthfeel. Large, ivory-white, highly uniform seeds deliver a light, premium color
and consistent quality. For decades it has been a favorite of top producers in Greece, Israel,
Lebanon, Turkey and across Europe thanks to reliable harvests and stable flavor profiles.

generosity, the Lebanese culinary experience will introduce you to a whole new way of enjoying food.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

## *Trace to the Farm*

foods** to retailers and supermarkets across Canada. We specialize in premium dates, tahini, olive
oil, Indian rice, pickled products, and spices.

What sets us apart is our **direct relationship with producers**. Our rice comes straight from
India, and our dates are sourced from our own family farm in Saudi Arabia — as well as Jordan and
Palestine — ensuring freshness and unmatched quality at every step.

From importing and transportation to packaging and storage, we oversee every detail so your shelves
receive the best products at the best price. We sell through **wholesale only** — contact us to ask
which retailers near you carry our products.

Tahini replaces the tools you cobble together — with one AI-powered platform that runs your finance,
inventory, and retail ops in the background.

What we do

## Four workflows. One platform. No more tool sprawl.

Tahini agents work the way your operators do — pulling from every system, reconciling across
channels, and surfacing only what needs a human.
* ### Multi-channel reconciliation
  
  Orders, returns, chargebacks, and inventory counts across every channel you sell on. DTC, Amazon,
  distributors, and retail partners, pulled, matched, and reconciled automatically. No more
  stitching together spreadsheets at month-end to figure out what actually happened.
* ### Inventory forecasting & planning
  
  Demand forecasts and reorder recommendations by SKU, by channel. Know what to buy and when, So
  you're not losing sales to stockouts or tying up cash in inventory that isn't moving. Tahini
  learns from your sales history, lead times, and seasonality to get sharper over time.
* ### Deduction recovery
  
  Retailers take money off every invoice — shortages, compliance fines, promo chargebacks — and most
  brands don't have the bandwidth to fight back. Tahini catches invalid deductions, files disputes
  automatically, and tracks every dollar through resolution. No ops contractors required.
* ### Real-time financials
  
  Tahini pulls from your accounting system, bank accounts, credit cards, and expense tools to give
  you one always-current view of cash flow, burn, P&L, and margin by channel. The numbers you
  normally see at month-end close, available in real time.

shortage and spoilage deductions grocery and club retailers take on every invoice.

## Health Benefits

##### Tahini is a nutritional powerhouse; it is a rich source of various vitamins and minerals,
##### proteins, unsaturated fatty acids, and fibers.

### Strong Bones

Tahini is rich in calcium, magnesium, and phosphorus, essential for strong bones, joint health, and
maintaining a robust skeletal structure.

### Weight Gain Control

Rich in healthy fats and protein, tahini supports balanced energy and promotes satiety, helping with
healthy weight management.

### Clear Airways of the Lungs

Tahini's anti-inflammatory properties and rich nutrient content may help support respiratory health,
promoting clearer airways and easier breathing.

### Relief from Migraine

Tahini is packed with magnesium, a mineral known to help relax blood vessels and reduce the
frequency and severity of migraines.

### Healthy Heart

Tahini is rich in heart-friendly nutrients like healthy fats, antioxidants, and magnesium, which
support cholesterol balance, reduce inflammation, and promote cardiovascular health.

### Sharp Brain

Packed with healthy fats, antioxidants, and essential nutrients, tahini supports brain health,
enhances memory, and boosts cognitive function.

### Menopausal Pain Relief

Tahini is rich in phytoestrogens and calcium, which can help balance hormones, reduce discomfort,
and support bone health during menopause.

### Glowing Skin and much more

Rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and healthy fats, tahini nourishes the skin from within, promoting a
radiant glow while offering numerous overall health benefits.

### Visit Lebanon

Delicious, nutritious, and flavorful are a few words that describe Lebanese cuisine. Its culinary
richness always provides a memorable encounter at the table. Its delightful flavors win over the
hearts (and stomachs) of food lovers worldwide. Each bite will whisk you off your feet and embark

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

## what is tahini?


Tahini is a creamy, nutritious paste made from ground sesame seeds, an ingredient that dates back
thousands of years to ancient Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisines. Traditionally used in
dishes like hummus, baba ghanoush, and halva, tahini has become a pantry staple around the world for
its rich, nutty flavor and silky texture.

[LEARN MORE][50]

## the secret is in the seeds

**We source the highest quality sesame seeds to create a mildly nutty, silky-smooth tahini that's
easy to mix!**

[Soom tahini jars on a colorful tile background with lemons and chickpeas.]

### silky-smooth

We source seeds with a high oil-to-meat ratio and blend them to perfection using age old techniques.
The result is a silky-smooth consistency that can't be beat!

### easy to mix

Because of our premium seeds and special grinding process, Soom tahini separates less than the
others. If you do need to mix, it's quick and easy, unlike those other rock hard brands.

### mild nutty flavor

High quality seeds that are roasted at the right temperatures result in tahini that is mildly nutty
and not overly bitter. Soom tahini brings balance and flavor to any dish!

[
][51]

### big flavor for everyday meals, in one easy squeeze

Tahini has never been this easy, or this flavorful. Made from real, simple ingredients, Soom squeeze
bottles deliver smooth tahini and bold, globally-inspired flavors in one effortless drizzle.

No stirring, no prep, less mess. Just shake, squeeze, and drizzle for faster meals, finished dishes,
and silky sauces in seconds.

Arabic cooking. It’s an important element to slow-cooked tagines, along with turmeric, cumin,
ginger, and cinnamon.

## ****Our Sesame seeds****

**At Albaik Tahini, we carefully select our sesame seeds based on taste, color, and oil content to

## **Frequently Asked Question**

What is Tahini?

**Tahini** is a creamy paste made from ground sesame seeds. It is a versatile ingredient widely used
in Middle Eastern, Mediterranean, and North African cuisines. Tahini is both nutritious and
flavorful, making it a popular choice for savory and sweet dishes.

**How long Tahini is good for**?

It can last up to two years if it is stored correctly and not exposed to water or any other food.
Store in a cool, dark place, such as a pantry. It can also be refrigerated which helps to keep it
more fresh.

**What are some ways to enjoy Tahini?**

**Use It as a Dip or Spread :**
Classic Tahini Sauce: Mix tahini with lemon juice, garlic, water, and a pinch of salt for a creamy
sauce. Perfect for drizzling on falafel, roasted vegetables, or salads.
Tahini Dip: Blend tahini with yogurt, olive oil, and a bit of cumin for a quick, flavorful dip for
pita bread, crackers, or raw veggies.
On Toast: Spread tahini on bread or toast and top with honey or jam for a simple, nutritious snack.

**Add It to Sauces and Dressings**:
Salad Dressing: Whisk tahini with lemon juice, olive oil, and a touch of maple syrup for a creamy
and tangy salad dressing.
Pasta Sauce: Mix tahini with garlic, soy sauce, and water for a nutty and savory pasta sauce.
Grain Bowls: Drizzle tahini over quinoa or rice bowls for added creaminess and flavor.

**Incorporate It in Cooking:**
Marinades: Use tahini as a base for marinades for chicken, fish, or tofu, adding garlic, lemon, and
spices for depth.
Soups and Stews: Stir a spoonful of tahini into soups or stews to add creaminess and richness
without dairy.
Stuffed Vegetables: Use tahini as a topping for stuffed eggplants or zucchini.

**Use It in Baking**:
Cookies: Add tahini to cookie dough for a nutty twist on traditional recipes.
Brownies: Swirl tahini into brownie batter for a rich, nutty flavor.

## **Frequently Asked Question**

What is Tahini?

**Tahini** is a creamy paste made from ground sesame seeds. It is a versatile ingredient widely used
in Middle Eastern, Mediterranean, and North African cuisines. Tahini is both nutritious and
flavorful, making it a popular choice for savory and sweet dishes.

**How long Tahini is good for**?

It can last up to two years if it is stored correctly and not exposed to water or any other food.
Store in a cool, dark place, such as a pantry. It can also be refrigerated which helps to keep it
more fresh.

**What are some ways to enjoy Tahini?**

**Use It as a Dip or Spread :**
Classic Tahini Sauce: Mix tahini with lemon juice, garlic, water, and a pinch of salt for a creamy
sauce. Perfect for drizzling on falafel, roasted vegetables, or salads.
Tahini Dip: Blend tahini with yogurt, olive oil, and a bit of cumin for a quick, flavorful dip for
pita bread, crackers, or raw veggies.
On Toast: Spread tahini on bread or toast and top with honey or jam for a simple, nutritious snack.

**Add It to Sauces and Dressings**:
Salad Dressing: Whisk tahini with lemon juice, olive oil, and a touch of maple syrup for a creamy
and tangy salad dressing.
Pasta Sauce: Mix tahini with garlic, soy sauce, and water for a nutty and savory pasta sauce.
Grain Bowls: Drizzle tahini over quinoa or rice bowls for added creaminess and flavor.

**Incorporate It in Cooking:**
Marinades: Use tahini as a base for marinades for chicken, fish, or tofu, adding garlic, lemon, and
spices for depth.
Soups and Stews: Stir a spoonful of tahini into soups or stews to add creaminess and richness
without dairy.
Stuffed Vegetables: Use tahini as a topping for stuffed eggplants or zucchini.

**Use It in Baking**:
Cookies: Add tahini to cookie dough for a nutty twist on traditional recipes.
Brownies: Swirl tahini into brownie batter for a rich, nutty flavor.
Cakes: Substitute tahini for some of the butter or oil in cake recipes for a moist and flavorful
result.

**Sweet Treats:**
Tahini and Honey Spread: Mix tahini with honey or maple syrup for a delicious spread for bread or
pancakes.
Halva: Enjoy tahini-based halva, a traditional Middle Eastern sweet made with sugar and nuts.
Smoothies: Add a spoonful of tahini to your morning smoothie for a creamy texture and a boost of
nutrients.

**Use It as a Condiment:**
Topping for Roasted Veggies: Drizzle tahini over roasted cauliflower, sweet potatoes, or carrots.
Sandwich Spread: Replace mayonnaise with tahini in sandwiches or wraps for a healthier alternative.
Burgers: Spread tahini on veggie or beef burgers for an extra layer of flavor.

**Enjoy It Straight**:
With Fruits or Veggies: Use tahini as a dip for apple slices, banana chunks, celery sticks, or
carrots.
Plain: A spoonful of tahini by itself is a quick, energy-boosting snack!

**How is freshly stone milled Tahini better?**

**Natural Taste:** Stone milling preserves the natural, nutty flavor of sesame seeds better than
high-speed industrial grinders, which can generate heat and alter the flavor.
**Enhanced Aroma: **Freshly milled tahini has a rich, robust aroma that is often lost in
mass-produced versions.

OUR PROCESS

## Crafted with Intention

[Premium Sesame Seeds]
[Traditional Stone-Grinding]
[Small Batch Production]
[Zero Additives, Ever]
[Shipped Fresh to Your Door]
01

### Premium Sesame Seeds

We source only the finest sesame seeds, carefully selected for their purity, rich flavour, and high
oil content. Every batch is hand-inspected before grinding.

02

### Traditional Stone-Grinding

Our tahini is slowly stone-ground the traditional way cool temperatures preserve natural oils and
nutrients, delivering a depth of flavour that machine processing can't match.

03

### Small Batch Production

We produce in small batches to guarantee freshness and consistency. Every jar receives our full
attention quality over volume, every single time.

04

### Zero Additives, Ever

Just pure sesame seeds. No added oils, no preservatives, no stabilizers. What you see on the label
is exactly what's in the jar — nothing more, nothing less.

05

### Shipped Fresh to Your Door

Every order is packed and shipped within days of production from our Mississauga facility. You
receive tahini at its freshest — never sitting in a warehouse for months.

### KEY BENEFITS OF CANNING

Canning is a popular method of food preservation that offers several significant advantages:
- **Long Shelf Life**: One of the primary benefits of canning is that it extends the shelf life of
foods. Properly canned foods can last for years without refrigeration, making them a reliable option
for long-term storage.
- **Nutritional Retention**: Canning helps preserve the nutritional value of foods. The process
typically involves heating the food to kill bacteria and enzymes, which helps maintain vitamins and
minerals effectively.
- **Convenience**: Canned foods are incredibly convenient. They are pre-cooked and ready to eat,
which saves time in meal preparation. This is especially beneficial for busy lifestyles or during
emergencies when fresh food may not be available.
- **Reduced Food Waste**: By canning surplus fruits and vegetables, individuals can minimize food
waste. This is particularly useful during harvest seasons when there is an abundance of produce.
- **Cost-Effectiveness**: Canning can be a cost-effective way to preserve seasonal produce. Buying
in bulk when prices are low and canning them for later use can lead to significant savings.
- **Flavor and Variety**: Canned foods can offer a wide variety of flavors and options throughout
the year, regardless of the season. This allows for diverse meal planning and enjoyment of different
foods year-round.

In summary, **canning is an effective method for preserving food that provides long shelf life,
retains nutritional value, offers convenience, reduces waste, and can be cost-effective while
enhancing meal variety**.

In the search for the best solution, for food that is ecologically, but also nutritionally and
healthily acceptable, we find ourselves at a crossroads, where it is important to make a responsible
decision for ourselves and for the environment. Although there have been prejudices about canned
food for years, all research confirms that this mode of consumption has a high ecological value both
in terms of nutritional values and in terms of packaging that meets the three sustainability
requirements: reduce, reuse and recycle. Knowledge and information are the best weapons in the fight
against global and personal problems, so let's start breaking down the prejudices that circulate
when it comes to canned food.

* Relieve critical resource shortages such as labor and ingredients
* Provide wholesale food premium frozen hors d’oeuvres and desserts
* Enable you to concentrate on your core business by outsourcing peripheral items
* Ensure consistency of food cost and product
* Cost savings for product research and development
* Reduce overhead costs

# Premium Wholesale Food Manufacturer

Chef’s Commissary is a wholesale food manufacturer. Our savory hors d’oeuvres and breakfast items
are available nationwide through your favorite distributor and are created especially for chefs
operating in hotels, convention centers, schools, restaurants, hospitality centers, and catering
companies.

Contact us for more information or to schedule a custom tasting by calling us at 407-877-6922.

#### [Keto Clarity Hub][56]

The ketogenic diet is a high-fat, low-carbohydrate eating plan designed to induce ketosis, a
metabolic state in which the body burns fat for fuel instead of carbohydrates.

#### [The Paleo Diet][57]

The paleo diet emphasizes eating like early humans, focusing on whole foods and excluding grains,
dairy, and processed items.

#### [The High Fat Diet][58]

The high-fat diet is rich in fats and often low in carbohydrates, aiming to promote ketosis or
improve body composition.

#### [Beyond Grains][59]

A no-grains diet eliminates all grain products, including wheat, rice, and corn, focusing on other
whole foods.

explore the science and real-world results behind each eating plan.

eater. Welcome to a world of flexible dining.

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

## Mediterranean at Scale – Falafel Manufacturer

Specializing in the production and distribution of authentic Mediterranean foods for, retail,
[wholesale a­nd foodservice][22] markets worldwide. Haflé Foods products are made with an unwavering
commitment to quality, consistency, and authenticity. Using all-natural ingredients, our traditional
and unique flavors provide both the authentic taste and quality consumers expect from Middle Eastern
cuisine.

From small specialty retailers to major food distributors Haflé Foods has the manufacturing
expertise and production capacity needed to meet growing consumer demand for authentic Mediterranean
foods.

We serve as a reliable manufacturing partner for businesses seeking [premium falafel products,
including frozen falafel options][23].

[Haflé falafel are free of artificial flavors, preservatives and gluten. and a good soucre of
protein.]

## Our Products

### Traditional Authentic Recipes + Modern Production Methods

Our falafel manufacturing process begins with [time-honored family recipes][24] using premium
chickpeas, fresh Mediterranean herbs, and carefully balanced spices including cumin and traditional
seasonings. Haflé products capture the true essence of Mediterranean flavor creating [falafel
products][25] that maintain authentic flavor profiles across all formats, including our popular
frozen falafel line.

Utilizing advanced techniques and cold chain management, our state-of-the-art manufacturing
facilities maintain the nutritional integrity and taste of our falafel products. Every batch
undergoes rigorous quality control to ensure consistent texture, flavor, and appearance across all
production runs.

### Falafel

Blend of garbanzo beans, fresh veggies, herbs, spices, great for salads, bowls, wraps, and dips.

[Explore][26]

### TAHINI

Organic sesame seeds tahini. Great for dips, salad dressing, and hummus.

[Explore][27]

### FALAFEL MIX

Our ready-to-mix falafel blend brings authentic flavor in minutes.

[Explore][28]

## Why Partner With Haflé Foods

**Scalability and Reliability: **As an established food manufacturer, Haflé Foods possesses the
production capacity to fulfill orders ranging from small specialty runs to large-scale distribution
contracts. Our supply chain reliability ensures consistent product availability, helping partners
maintain steady inventory levels and meet customer demand.

**Manufacturing Flexibility:** Different markets require different solutions. Our manufacturing
capabilities include:
* **Recipe Customization — **Adapt spice levels, ingredient profiles, and dietary specifications
* **Packaging Variations — **From retail consumer packs to [bulk foodservice packaging][29]
* **Portion Control — **Multiple size options to match specific market requirements

**Strategic Partnership Approach**: Beyond manufacturing, Haflé Foods serves as a true business
partner, providing market insights, product development support and flexible terms that help our
clients successfully grow their Mediterranean food offerings.

## Distribution And Packaging Capabilities

Haflé Foods’ comprehensive distribution network serves a wide range of distribution channels:

**Food Distributors** — Bulk quantities with flexible delivery schedules

## How We Work

#### Primary Research

The primary research is performed by taking the interviews of executives of various companies
dealing in the market as well as using the survey reports, research institute, and latest research
reports. Meanwhile, analyst team keeps preparing set of questionnaires and after getting appointee
list; the target audience are then tapped and segregated with various mediums and channels that are
feasible for making connection.

#### Secondary Research

The secondary resources considered for the study include company annual reports, press releases,
published articles of organizations and associations, and the survey taken through different
mediums. In addition, the valuable strategic information obtained from industry association, paid
database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and
insights.

[images]

#### Data Validation

Once the primary & secondary research phase is completed, the collected information is framed
stating a view point of current market status. The most important question is the ongoing scenarios
of the market and correlating recent development activity; this must be utilized before any
player/manufacturer can go and formulate business plans and strategic tactics.

#### Report Compilation

Our research methodology is a built-in philosophy of quality assurance & control and continuing
improvement is integral to the HTF Market Intelligence culture. Each analyst team bears final
responsibility for the quality and accuracy of their reports. This is achieved through a process of
cross-verification and comparison among alternative estimators. Estimates are thus verified and
refined to help guarantee superior, accurate results for our clients.

göre sevkiyat analizleri sunar. Rakip firmaların hangi alıcılara, ne miktarda, hangi tarihlerde
yükleme yaptığını tam şeffaflıkla inceleyebilir ve tedarik zincirindeki hareketleri gerçek zamanlı

#### Bulunan Potansiyel Alıcı Analizleri

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular - Dış Ticaret & Gümrük İstihbaratı

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

### S: TurkExim verileri ile pazar araştırması ve rakip analizi nasıl yapılır?

Sistem üzerinden hedef ürününüzün **GTİP (HS Code)** numarasını sorguladığınızda şu analizlere
erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.
* Rakiplerinizin yurt dışındaki müşterileri, hangi limanları kullandıkları ve yükleme sıklıkları.
* Süreklilik arz eden, finansal riski düşük ve gümrük işlemi düzenli olan sürdürülebilir ihracat
  kanalları.

## Empanadas

From Jim Food - The Best Empanada Manufacturer

**Empanadas** are delicious and multi-functional food items. Obviously, you can eat them as a snack
or a meal. Furthermore, they are great for breakfast, lunch or dinner. Equally important, we offer
variety in formats. First, there are three dough (crust) type. Second, they come in three different
sizes. Finally, the product suite has a multitude of fillings composed of wholesome ingredients.

[LEARN MORE][10]
   TEQUEÑOS   

## Tequeños

Cheese Fingers

Evidently, **Tequeños** are traditionally filled with **Cheese**. However, the **Guava & Cheese**
combination has experienced a significant demand. In addition, our **R&D** has devised products that
include other fillings. For instance, **Chocolate** is a popular filling recently used.
Nevertheless, these appetizers are available in three sizes. Yet, they can be consumed for
breakfast, lunch or dinner. Meanwhile, they can be applied to many foodservice programs. First, they
are perfect for deli or coffee shops. Second, they fit amazingly as a menu item or hors d'oeuvres.
Of course, **Jim Food** is the best wholesale supplier of these goodies.

[LEARN MORE][11]
  LATIN MEALS    

## Latin American

[**Prepared Meals**][12]

First, our [**Prepared Meals**][13]*** ***crafted with wholesome ingredients. Second, they have a
deep understanding of culture, flavors and gastronomy. Next, they are prepared and packaged ideally
for foodservice. Finally, the concept can be applied to private label and retail. Moreover, many of
the products offer high nutrition values.

[LEARN MORE][14]
    ASIAN MEALS    

**Asian**

Again, J**im Food **[**Asian Prepared Meals**][15] are authentic gastronomic solutions. Furthermore,
we created them with a variety of foodservice verticals in mind.

Equally important, We have perfected several protein-based meals that are distinguishable. Of
course, they are the best meal options for an Asian style dining experience.

[LEARN MORE][16]

**Our Guiding Principles**

##### QUALITY

First, the creation of all our products are composed with the highest quality ingredients available.
Moreover, our USDA certified plant follows and meets requirements. Obviously, this is reflected in
the quality of all our products.

##### SUSTAINABILITY

Although, we focus on the quality, we care about our environment. Besides, we practice minimizing
waste. Nevertheless, it fits our philosophy of offering profitable solutions. Furthermore, it is
reflected in our business, everyday.

Most importantly, **Jim Group Inc**. believes in developing and expanding partnerships. For example,
we offer scalable solution to grow our partners' businesses. Meanwhile, we align our business to
maximize the overarching strategy. Indeed, your win, is our win.

##### SERVICE

Besides quality, we are big on service. For instance, our customers appreciate the support we offer.
Furthermore, we work smart to strengthen our partnerships. Besides, we enjoy extending our

Welcome to the official website of K. MIKEDEM GENERAL IMPORT AND EXPORT ENTERPRISE. We are a company

exporting coffee, sesame seed, pulses, and tahini. Our target audience includes potential buyers of

## ABOUT US

Welcome to K. Mikedem, your gateway to the rich flavors of Ethiopia! With over 20 years of
experience, we specialize in exporting premium coffee, sesame seeds, oilseeds, and spices to Japan,
the Middle East and all over the world. 


Our commitment goes beyond quality products; we prioritize ethical sourcing and community upliftment

## Coffee Division

K.mikedem has recently secured an international organic certification for our coffee exports from
one of our processing station in Yirgacheffe and our cleaning and packing warehouse in Addis Ababa.

We are also have  Rain-forest alliance (RFA) certificate. This certification, encompassing 360
farmers, ensures consistent volume and high-quality coffee. We are committed to expanding our reach
by including more farmers and certifying additional coffee processing stations in the Guji area.

As one of the few Ethiopian green coffee exporters with this prestigious certification, we offer
full traceability of our organic coffee back to the farmers.

## Our Sesame

We offer a full range of premium sesame seeds  including machine-cleaned, sortex-cleaned, hulled,
and tahini , all processed at our in-house cleaning facilities equipped with a state of the art
Cimbria processing line. Our machine-cleaned sesame is purified through multi-stage mechanical
cleaning; sortex-cleaned sesame is color-sorted for uniformity and visual quality; hulled sesame is
processed to remove the outer shell while preserving nutrients; and tahini-grade sesame is specially
selected for its high oil content and ideal texture. Every product meets international food safety
and export standards, ensuring top quality from farm to shipment.

## The U.S. Standard for Premium Tahini

Lebanese tahini made in Canton, Michigan USA, stone ground daily from Sudanese Qadarif sesame seeds
for smooth texture and authentic flavor. Trusted by Metro Detroit chefs and nationwide hummus
manufacturers, our tahini is Non-GMO, Kosher, ISO 22000 and SQF certified, delivering consistent
quality since 2011.

## Three Truths About Our Tahini

[Premium golden sesame seeds, hand-selected for Lebanese Queen tahini]
1

### We start with Better Seeds

Our Sudanese sesame seeds have the right oil content and color. That's why our tahini stays creamy
and never turns to concrete.

[Creamy tahini being poured, showing smooth stone-ground texture]
2

### We grind it the right way

Stone-ground daily at our SQF certified facility in Canton, Michigan. Traditional Lebanese methods
meet modern American food safety standards.

[Beautiful hummus platter with golden tahini drizzle]
3

### It actually works and tastes right

No more wrestling with rock-hard, bitter tahini. No more oil lakes that won't mix. Just tahini that
works with the mild nutty flavor and texture, exactly how it should.

Promises backed by our certifications, our process, and thousands of satisfied customers.

[ Experience Real Tahini ][17]

## What is Tahini?

Tahini is a creamy paste made from ground sesame seeds, used for over 4,000 years in Mediterranean
and Middle Eastern cuisine. With 17g of protein and 426mg of calcium per 100g serving, tahini
delivers plant-based nutrition that rivals dairy while adding rich, nutty flavor to any dish.

From morning smoothies to dinner marinades, tahini is the superfood your pantry has been missing.
Join millions who've already discovered why tahini is the ultimate cooking upgrade.

[ Shop Premium Tahini Now ][18]

## Frequently Asked Questions

What makes Lebanese Queen Tahini different from other brands?
Lebanese Queen Tahini is made using traditional Lebanese methods passed down through generations. We
use only 100% pure sesame seeds, stone-ground daily without any additives, preservatives, or oils,
creating an authentic taste and creamy texture.
Is Lebanese Queen Tahini gluten-free and vegan?
Yes! Our tahini is naturally gluten-free, vegan, GMO-free, dairy-free, and contains no added sugars.
It's made from just one ingredient: 100% pure sesame seeds, making it perfect for various dietary
preferences.
Where can I buy Lebanese Queen Tahini?
You can purchase our tahini directly from our website, or find us at select retailers across the
United States. We also offer wholesale options for restaurants, retailers, and food manufacturers.
How should I store tahini after opening?
After opening, store tahini in the refrigerator for optimal freshness. It will last 4-6 months
refrigerated. Natural oil separation is normal - simply stir before use. Store upside down to keep
oils mixed.
What are the health benefits of tahini?
Tahini is rich in healthy fats, protein, and essential minerals like calcium, magnesium, and iron.
It supports heart health, provides sustained energy, and contains antioxidants that help reduce
inflammation.
How do I use tahini in cooking?
Tahini is incredibly versatile! Use it in hummus, baba ghanoush, salad dressings, smoothies, or as a
spread. It's perfect for both sweet and savory dishes, from Middle Eastern classics to modern fusion
recipes.
Is your facility certified?
Yes, our facility in Canton, Michigan holds ISO 22000 and GFSI certifications, ensuring the highest
standards of food safety and quality. All our products are also Kosher certified.
Do you offer wholesale pricing?
Yes! We offer competitive wholesale pricing for restaurants, retailers, and food manufacturers.
Visit our wholesale page or contact us directly to discuss volume pricing and partnership
opportunities.

## What is Tahini?

Tahini is a creamy paste made from ground sesame seeds, used for over 4,000 years in Mediterranean
and Middle Eastern cuisine. With 17g of protein and 426mg of calcium per 100g serving, tahini
delivers plant-based nutrition that rivals dairy while adding rich, nutty flavor to any dish.

From morning smoothies to dinner marinades, tahini is the superfood your pantry has been missing.
Join millions who've already discovered why tahini is the ultimate cooking upgrade.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What makes Lebanese Queen Tahini different from other brands?
Lebanese Queen Tahini is made using traditional Lebanese methods passed down through generations. We
use only 100% pure sesame seeds, stone-ground daily without any additives, preservatives, or oils,
creating an authentic taste and creamy texture.
Is Lebanese Queen Tahini gluten-free and vegan?
Yes! Our tahini is naturally gluten-free, vegan, GMO-free, dairy-free, and contains no added sugars.
It's made from just one ingredient: 100% pure sesame seeds, making it perfect for various dietary
preferences.
Where can I buy Lebanese Queen Tahini?
You can purchase our tahini directly from our website, or find us at select retailers across the
United States. We also offer wholesale options for restaurants, retailers, and food manufacturers.
How should I store tahini after opening?
After opening, store tahini in the refrigerator for optimal freshness. It will last 4-6 months
refrigerated. Natural oil separation is normal - simply stir before use. Store upside down to keep
oils mixed.
What are the health benefits of tahini?
Tahini is rich in healthy fats, protein, and essential minerals like calcium, magnesium, and iron.
It supports heart health, provides sustained energy, and contains antioxidants that help reduce
inflammation.
How do I use tahini in cooking?
Tahini is incredibly versatile! Use it in hummus, baba ghanoush, salad dressings, smoothies, or as a
spread. It's perfect for both sweet and savory dishes, from Middle Eastern classics to modern fusion
recipes.
Is your facility certified?
Yes, our facility in Canton, Michigan holds ISO 22000 and GFSI certifications, ensuring the highest
standards of food safety and quality. All our products are also Kosher certified.
Do you offer wholesale pricing?
Yes! We offer competitive wholesale pricing for restaurants, retailers, and food manufacturers.
Visit our wholesale page or contact us directly to discuss volume pricing and partnership
opportunities.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is tahini?

Tahini is a creamy spread made from ground sesame seeds, known for its smooth texture and nutty,
earthy flavor. It's a versatile ingredient used in both savory and sweet dishes.

Is tahini healthy?

Yes, tahini is a nutrient-dense food packed with healthy fats, plant-based protein, and essential
minerals like calcium and iron. It supports heart and bone health.

Why should I choose organic tahini?

Organic tahini is free from synthetic pesticides and chemicals, offering a cleaner, more natural
option. It’s ideal for health-conscious and eco-minded consumers.

What are the health benefits of consuming tahini?

Tahini is rich in antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds. Regular consumption may help with
cholesterol management, digestion, and overall immune support.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is tahini?

Tahini is a creamy spread made from ground sesame seeds, known for its smooth texture and nutty,
earthy flavor. It's a versatile ingredient used in both savory and sweet dishes.

Is tahini healthy?

Yes, tahini is a nutrient-dense food packed with healthy fats, plant-based protein, and essential
minerals like calcium and iron. It supports heart and bone health.

Why should I choose organic tahini?

Organic tahini is free from synthetic pesticides and chemicals, offering a cleaner, more natural
option. It’s ideal for health-conscious and eco-minded consumers.

What are the health benefits of consuming tahini?

Tahini is rich in antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds. Regular consumption may help with
cholesterol management, digestion, and overall immune support.

Where can I buy Mighty Sesame tahini online?

While you can't buy directly from our website, each product page links you to Amazon for convenient
shopping. You can also use our [store locator][68] to find the nearest retailer that carries Mighty
Sesame tahini.

Is tahini suitable for vegans?

Absolutely. Tahini is 100% plant-based, containing no animal-derived ingredients. It's a great
choice for vegan and vegetarian diets.

Why do some people think tahini is bitter?

Bitterness can come from over-roasted or unhulled sesame seeds. Mighty Sesame uses carefully
sourced, lightly roasted seeds to create a balanced, smooth flavor.

Is Mighty Sesame tahini gluten-free?

Yes, our organic tahini is naturally gluten-free and made without additives or preservatives -
suitable and best for those with gluten sensitivities or celiac disease.

  Our tahini is expertly milled for a naturally silky-smooth texture, ensuring effortless blending
  in hummus, halva, and sauces. No grittiness, minimum separation—just pure, creamy perfection in
  every batch.
* #### Naturally Balanced Flavor
  
  Our tahini delivers a naturally balanced flavor—nutty, smooth, and pure, with sweet tastes.
  Perfectly crafted to enhance hummus, halva, and culinary creations without bitterness.
* #### Customizable Roasting & Grinding Levels
  
  Our tahini is tailor-made to match your recipe, with adjustable roasting and grinding levels to
  achieve the perfect flavor, color, and texture for your hummus, halva, and sauces.

  Designed for manufacturers, restaurant chains, and professional kitchens, our tahini delivers
  smooth, reliable performance in high-volume mixing. Our engineers test every batch, ensuring
  consistency in texture, color grade, and flavor at every stage—from production to final product."

  stage. From raw sesame selection to final packaging, our engineers oversee every step to ensure

[Alt] where it all started 1896 Charles Rao, who immigrated with his parents from the southern
Italian town of Polla, buys a small tavern on 114th St and Pleasant Avenue in an Italian
neighborhood of New York City 2019 1930 [Alt] 1930 Charles’ sons, Vincent and Louis Rao take over
Rao’s and manage to keep the business open through the prohibition years. 1896 1958 [Alt] 1958 After
Louis’ passing, Vincent Rao takes over the family business and begins transitioning the tavern into
a restaurant by introducing southern Italian dishes. 1930 1974 [Alt] 1974 Anna Pellegrino Rao begins
working with her husband Vincent and brings an expertise in southern Italian cuisine and an elegant
style to help the Rao’s restaurant gain prominence. The restaurant begins to collect a number of
“regulars” from the neighborhood and beyond. 1958 1975 [Alt] 1975 Frank Pellegrino Sr. begins
helping his aunt and uncle at Rao’s. Over the years, Frank emerges as the leader, heart and soul of
Rao’s and becomes one of the foremost restauranteurs in America. Frank’s emphasis on simple, pure,
delicious ingredients vastly improves the perception, taste and healthfulness of southern Italian
cuisine. Frank Sr.’s notoriety and authentic Italian presence landed him rolls in Warner Brothers’
“Goodfellas” and HBO’s “The Sopranos.” 1974 1977 [Alt] 1977 Famed New York Times restaurant critic,
Mimi Sheraton, gives Rao’s a glowing 3-star review stating Rao’s serves “wonderfully simple,
delicious and honest Italian food, all prepared strictly alla casaligna – home style.” This turns
Rao’s into one of the hottest restaurants in NYC. To remain loyal to their “regulars,” Rao’s assigns
“table rights” for specific nights of the week or month. The rights were prized family possessions
passed from generation to generation. 1975 1982 [Alt] 1982 At just 12 years-old, Frank Pellegrino
Jr. became the fourth generation of the Rao’s family to work at the restaurant. This begins a career
of over 35 years working at Rao’s. 1977 1992 [Alt] 1992 Tired of saying “no” to people who want
reservations, Frank Pellegrino Sr. decides to package and sell Rao’s sauce, “so this way I don’t
have to say ‘no’ anymore and everybody can have it at home.” Rao’s Homemade Pasta Sauce is born with
only the best ingredients and refused to add sugar, tomato paste, water, starches, fillers or color.
Characteristics that still are central to the product line today. 1982 1997 [Alt] 1997 Rao’s
Homemade Pasta Sauce Begins to expand, introducing flavors like spicy Arrabbiata and Puttanesca for
people to try in their own kitchen. 1992 2005 [Alt] 2005 Rao’s Homemade continues to develop
traditional sauces like Tomato Basil and Sausage & Mushroom. 1997 2017 [Alt] 2017 Rao’s Homemade
celebrates 25 years of bringing one of the best-tasting sauces home. 2005 2018 [Alt] 2018 Rao’s
Homemade continues to expand their sauce flavors offering Alfredo sauce and also begins offering dry
pasta. 2017 2019 [Alt] 2019 Rao’s Homemade begins offering soup, bring high-quality ingredients and
flavors to another part of your pantry. 2018 1896 TIMELINE

ensuring superior taste, nutritional value, and consistent quality in every product.

Private Label

We specialize in producing high-quality private label tahini for leading brands worldwide. Our
commitment to premium sesame seeds ensures exceptional taste and consistency. All products are
available in various sizes and tailored to meet specific customer needs. Decades of expertise give
us a competitive edge in quality and professionalism. Global brands trust our fully automated,
advanced production process. Our dedicated team upholds the highest industry standards for safety
and excellence. Partner with us to create your own premium tahini brand with confidence.

[ Read More ][61]

Packer Brand

We offer a seamless **Packer Brand** solution, allowing retailers and brands owners to create custom
tahini products with tailored packaging. From private grocery chains to specialty food brands, we
provide fully branded, market ready tahini solutions. Our advanced production capabilities enable
flexibility in packaging sizes, designs, and labeling. With premium ingredients and cutting-edge
automation, we ensure consistency, quality, and compliance.

Clients benefit from a hassl free process, from concept to shelf ready products. Whether you need a
unique label, packaging format, or custom formulation, we deliver to your exact specifications. Let
us help you bring your tahini brand to life with efficiency and expertise.

## Health Benefits

##### Tahini is a nutritional powerhouse; it is a rich source of various vitamins and minerals,
##### proteins, unsaturated fatty acids, and fibers.

### Strong Bones

Tahini is rich in calcium, magnesium, and phosphorus, essential for strong bones, joint health, and
maintaining a robust skeletal structure.

### Weight Gain Control

Rich in healthy fats and protein, tahini supports balanced energy and promotes satiety, helping with
healthy weight management.

### Clear Airways of the Lungs

Tahini's anti-inflammatory properties and rich nutrient content may help support respiratory health,
promoting clearer airways and easier breathing.

### Relief from Migraine

Tahini is packed with magnesium, a mineral known to help relax blood vessels and reduce the
frequency and severity of migraines.

### Healthy Heart

Tahini is rich in heart-friendly nutrients like healthy fats, antioxidants, and magnesium, which
support cholesterol balance, reduce inflammation, and promote cardiovascular health.

### Sharp Brain

Packed with healthy fats, antioxidants, and essential nutrients, tahini supports brain health,
enhances memory, and boosts cognitive function.

### Menopausal Pain Relief

Tahini is rich in phytoestrogens and calcium, which can help balance hormones, reduce discomfort,
and support bone health during menopause.

### Glowing Skin and much more

Rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and healthy fats, tahini nourishes the skin from within, promoting a
radiant glow while offering numerous overall health benefits.

[[barake]][18]

its tahini (organic and whole grain sesame) and halva (family and bite size, as well as halva by

squeezable bottle, and has since been patented by the company.

El Hilal, (“moon”), symbolizes the counting of the Ramadan month, was created with the founding of
Rushdi and existed for almost 30 years. Leading with the slogan “El Hilal from a good family”, it
was created specifically to appeal to the Arab population, and sells exclusive product variations in
the tahini and halva world. Each year with the Ramadan month, El Hilal launches new “innovations” to
their halva products, connecting further with the company’s target market.

magic of sesame around the world”. As the name implies, the mightiness of the small sesame seed
connects to the brands slogan of “feel mighty good” and their goal of . The brand sells the patented
squeezable bottle tahini, tahini in small weights and halva snacks.

## Servet Lezzetlerini Deneyenlerin Yorumları

Fıstıklı helvanın tadı bir harika, inşallah hep aynı kalitede devam eder. Krokanlar da çok iyi,
tahin zaten güzel. Devam... Tahin ve pekmeziniz zaten harikaydı. Şimdi de lokumlarınız, tahin
helvanız ve doğal barlar inanılmaz lezzetli. Hediyeniz için ayrıca çok teşekkürler. İyi çalısmalar
diliyorum. Problemsiz bir şekilde geldi. Ambalajlama harika, şimdiye kadar online satış kanallarında
böyle bir ambalaj görmedim. Bu kadar lezzetli nasıl yapabiliyorsunuz. Sizleri tebrik ediyorum.
Yediğim en lezzetli lokum. İyi ki varsınız. İlk defa alışveriş yaptım ve gerçekten kaliteli ürünler
teşekkürler. Yaaa resmen ben kahve falan içmiyormuşum dedim şu an! Bundan sonra başka kahve içmem.
Hem lezzetli, hem köpüklü. Daha ne isteyebilirim ki. Hayatımda yediğim en güzel pekmez ve tahindi
diyebilirim. İlk defa çifte kavrulmuş tahin aldım harikaydı. Hızlı kargo, sağlam ambalaj ve mükemmel
lezzet. Hayırlı işler diliyorum. Çok lezzetli, özlediğim gerçek balın tadını alabiliyorum. Orjinal
tat, güvenilir içerik, çok temiz ürünler. Tavsiye ediyorum denemenizi. Şeker ilavesiz kaju ezmesi,
fındık ezmesi, krokan ve çifte kavrulmuş tahin aldım. Tadı gerçekten taze lezzetli bir başka güzel.
Mis gibi de kokuyor. Çok lezzetli ve rafine şekersiz böyle bir lezzet! Tekrar tekrar sipariş
edeceğim. Kargo da çok özenliydi. Teşekkürler. Reklamlarda görüp sipariş verdim. Müthiş bir lezzet.
Tatlı sevmeyen insana bile kendini yedirir kıvamda. Paketleme ve kargo kusursuzdu. İşini özenle,
severek yapanların farkı. Unbelievably good!!! Thank you so much! Best tahini ever!!! Kahvesi son
derece hafif ve bol köpüklü. Mide rahatsızlığım olduğu için gönül rahatlığıyla içebildiğim tek
kahve. Gittiğim her yerde yanımda taşıyorum. Veganlar için harika bir tatlı alternatifi. Krokan
genelde sert olur, zor yerim. Bu taptaze ve ağızda dağılıyor bayıldım. Hızlı gönderi ve özenli
paketleme için teşekkür ederim. Tahin ve pekmez inanılmaz lezzetli. Diğer ürünlerinizden de en kısa
sürede sipariş verip deneyeceğim. Aldığım hiçbir üründen pişmanlık duymadım. Gönül rahatlığı ile
tüketiyorum. Şeker ilavesiz olması özellikle aradığım şeydi. Teşekkürler. Lokumlar aşırı iyi. hediye
olarak almıştım çok beğenildi. Yumuşak içim sevenler için ideal. Çok kavrulmuş sevmiyordum ve
aradığım kahve tam olarak bu. Daha önce de alışveriş yaptım. Her bir ürün birbirinden güzel ve
lezzetli... Kalite ve/veya güvenilirlik problemi düşünen varsa düşünmesin alsın derim. Teşekkürler.
Hayatımda yediğim en iyi yer fıstığı ezmesi. Pürüzsüz ve şeker ilavesiz olmasına rağmen lezzeti
mükemmel. 🌸

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

# Premium Tahini straight from the source!

At Tahinibros, we source the finest Humera Tahini from Ethiopia and other Tahini’s from the rest of
the world to match each customer with the perfect quality for their needs.

[quote][14]
[Tahini]
[Ethiopian woman with white sesame seeds]

## What makes Humera Tahini unique?

[White sesame seeds]

Humera sesame from Tigray (Ethiopia) thrives in a sunny microclimate with well-drained, fertile
soils. This yields seeds with a high oil content and a mild, lightly nutty, subtly sweet flavor –
without bitterness. The result is a creamy tahini that needs no flavor adjustments.

[Krotaj factory premium tahini ethiopia]

With its high oil content (±50–55%), the tahini is extra smooth, creamy, and slower to separate,
with a pleasant mouthfeel. Large, ivory-white, highly uniform seeds deliver a light, premium color
and consistent quality. For decades it has been a favorite of top producers in Greece, Israel,
Lebanon, Turkey and across Europe thanks to reliable harvests and stable flavor profiles.

## Benefits of Tahinibros

As an agent of Ethiopian Tahini manufacturers, we connect Humera’s unique quality with professional
clients across Europe. With years of industry experience, we guarantee clear communication, flexible
delivery options, and excellent service.

#### 01

### Premium quality

Our core product is the exceptional Humera Tahini, renowned for its rich flavor and smooth texture.
As the exclusive agent for leading Ethiopian producers, we bring this premium tahini directly from
the source to your doorstep, ensuring unmatched freshness and authenticity.

## 02

### Global sourcing

Thanks to our extensive global network, we can also identify and supply the ideal tahini for any
requirement – whether you’re seeking a specific taste profile, texture, or certification.

## 03

### Tailored & flexible

From 5 kg buckets to big bags, with white-label options, taste profile adjustments, and tender
support.

At Tahinibros, we source the finest Humera Tahini from Ethiopia and other Tahini’s from the rest of

## What makes Humera Tahini unique?

[White sesame seeds]

Humera sesame from Tigray (Ethiopia) thrives in a sunny microclimate with well-drained, fertile
soils. This yields seeds with a high oil content and a mild, lightly nutty, subtly sweet flavor –
without bitterness. The result is a creamy tahini that needs no flavor adjustments.

[Krotaj factory premium tahini ethiopia]

With its high oil content (±50–55%), the tahini is extra smooth, creamy, and slower to separate,
with a pleasant mouthfeel. Large, ivory-white, highly uniform seeds deliver a light, premium color
and consistent quality. For decades it has been a favorite of top producers in Greece, Israel,
Lebanon, Turkey and across Europe thanks to reliable harvests and stable flavor profiles.

known for their purity and flavor. Tahini is stone-ground or cold-pressed locally, supporting
Ethiopia’s agricultural economy while delivering exceptional quality.

## WELCOME TO TARANTINO FOODS, L.L.C.

**Tarantino Foods L.L.C.** is a privately owned wholesale food distributor serving independent

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

globally.

What we do

## Four workflows. One platform. No more tool sprawl.

Tahini agents work the way your operators do — pulling from every system, reconciling across
channels, and surfacing only what needs a human.
* ### Multi-channel reconciliation
  
  Orders, returns, chargebacks, and inventory counts across every channel you sell on. DTC, Amazon,
  distributors, and retail partners, pulled, matched, and reconciled automatically. No more
  stitching together spreadsheets at month-end to figure out what actually happened.
* ### Inventory forecasting & planning
  
  Demand forecasts and reorder recommendations by SKU, by channel. Know what to buy and when, So
  you're not losing sales to stockouts or tying up cash in inventory that isn't moving. Tahini
  learns from your sales history, lead times, and seasonality to get sharper over time.
* ### Deduction recovery
  
  Retailers take money off every invoice — shortages, compliance fines, promo chargebacks — and most
  brands don't have the bandwidth to fight back. Tahini catches invalid deductions, files disputes
  automatically, and tracks every dollar through resolution. No ops contractors required.
* ### Real-time financials
  
  Tahini pulls from your accounting system, bank accounts, credit cards, and expense tools to give
  you one always-current view of cash flow, burn, P&L, and margin by channel. The numbers you
  normally see at month-end close, available in real time.

Industries

## AI that understands your category.

Tahini adapts to the systems, seasonality, and retail dynamics that impact your bottom line.

Food & BeverageBeauty & Personal CareApparelHealth & WellnessHouseholdPet

### Food & Beverage

Perishable SKUs, unforgiving lead times.

Short shelf life and high velocity leave no room for a bad forecast. Tahini reconciles distributor
and DTC orders in real time, forecasts demand by SKU so you buy just enough, and claws back the
shortage and spoilage deductions grocery and club retailers take on every invoice.

Who it’s for

## Built for brands with complex operations.

Existing systems don't work together, teams rely on spreadsheets, and critical decisions take too
long. Tahini unifies data across DTC, Amazon, distributors, and retail, giving your team a single
source of truth for inventory, finance, and planning.

What we do

## Four workflows. One platform. No more tool sprawl.

Tahini agents work the way your operators do — pulling from every system, reconciling across
channels, and surfacing only what needs a human.
* ### Multi-channel reconciliation
  
  Orders, returns, chargebacks, and inventory counts across every channel you sell on. DTC, Amazon,
  distributors, and retail partners, pulled, matched, and reconciled automatically. No more
  stitching together spreadsheets at month-end to figure out what actually happened.
* ### Inventory forecasting & planning
  
  Demand forecasts and reorder recommendations by SKU, by channel. Know what to buy and when, So
  you're not losing sales to stockouts or tying up cash in inventory that isn't moving. Tahini
  learns from your sales history, lead times, and seasonality to get sharper over time.
* ### Deduction recovery
  
  Retailers take money off every invoice — shortages, compliance fines, promo chargebacks — and most
  brands don't have the bandwidth to fight back. Tahini catches invalid deductions, files disputes
  automatically, and tracks every dollar through resolution. No ops contractors required.
* ### Real-time financials
  
  Tahini pulls from your accounting system, bank accounts, credit cards, and expense tools to give
  you one always-current view of cash flow, burn, P&L, and margin by channel. The numbers you
  normally see at month-end close, available in real time.

#### Sesame Seeds

‘Open Sesame!’, the well-known phrase from the Arabian Nights is based on a distinguishing feature
of the sesame plant. The seed pod bursts open when they ripen and reach maturity!

[Explore][33]

#### Tahini

Tahini or tahina is made using hulled sesame. It is toasted and ground to make a paste which can be
served as a dip or as an ingredient in popular Middle-Eastern dishes such as hummus, baba ganoush,
and halawa.

[Explore][34]

#### Halawa

Halawa or Halvah is a general term for desserts made using flour and various nut butters. But in the
Middle East, Halawa refers to mainly one item – a sesame based confection that is not only
decadently delicious, but also highly nutritious.

[Explore][35]
About

## wilmington foods

Over the years, Wilmington Foods has established itself as a force to be reckoned with the
processing, trading & export of sesame seeds, tahini and halawa.
* With our high tech equipment and scientific handling methods, we harvest and process sesame seeds
  in such a manner that all its nutritional and medicinal values are preserved.
* We provide the world’s highest quality sesame seeds and are recognized as highly reliable sesame
  seeds exporters & suppliers in the Middle East.
* Only the best quality sesame seeds are procured from farmers across the African continent.
* Our range of sesame based products, processed in-house, include creamy Tahini and delicious
  Halawas. With our mechanized, BRC Certified facility, we hold the necessary expertise to produce &
  meet any scale of demand for sesame seeds & tahini.
* From bespoke packaging to tailored branding, we specialize in crafting Tahini private label
  options to align perfectly with your vision & brand presence.

[Read More][36]
Your Private Label

## Partner

Wilimington Foods helps you elevate your retail experience. Bring customers your carefully crafted
and branded private label foods right to the shelves of their local grocery store.

We have the expertise to take your private label product from concept to shelf with efficiency and
attention to detail. Whatever you’re looking for, we’ll help you get there. We’re your expert when
it comes to private label.

[Read More][37]

## choose us

Wilmington Foods offers its customers 100% pure sesame seeds that retain their original aroma and
taste. In every stage of our manufacturing operation, from sourcing the sesame seeds to processing
and testing the final product, we strive for excellence.

#### [ Our Mission ][41]

To enrich people’s lives by providing food products of exceptional quality and nutritional value. To
produce and supply the best quality sesame seeds and its derived products while ensuring that all of
their purity, natural aroma, nutritional and medicinal values are preserved.

[ [icon-box] ][42]

#### [ Our Vision ][43]

To become the leading provider and the one-stop shop for world’s best quality sesame seeds and
products by growing our own seeds on a land bank in Africa to ensure strict control over product
quality. To become a trustworthy partner to our clients by exceeding their expectation in every
aspect of our operation.

[ [icon-box] ][44]

#### [ Customer Focus ][45]

At Wilmington Foods, we pride ourselves on providing excellent customer service. With our ethical
business practices, and comprehensive product quality control, our clients can be assured of
commitments being fulfilled at any cost. Compared to market price, we offer value for your money by
providing the best quality sesame seeds at the best price points.

## **Frequently Asked Question**

What is Tahini?

**Tahini** is a creamy paste made from ground sesame seeds. It is a versatile ingredient widely used
in Middle Eastern, Mediterranean, and North African cuisines. Tahini is both nutritious and
flavorful, making it a popular choice for savory and sweet dishes.

**How long Tahini is good for**?

It can last up to two years if it is stored correctly and not exposed to water or any other food.
Store in a cool, dark place, such as a pantry. It can also be refrigerated which helps to keep it
more fresh.

Classic Tahini Sauce: Mix tahini with lemon juice, garlic, water, and a pinch of salt for a creamy
sauce. Perfect for drizzling on falafel, roasted vegetables, or salads.
Tahini Dip: Blend tahini with yogurt, olive oil, and a bit of cumin for a quick, flavorful dip for
pita bread, crackers, or raw veggies.
On Toast: Spread tahini on bread or toast and top with honey or jam for a simple, nutritious snack.

**Add It to Sauces and Dressings**:
Salad Dressing: Whisk tahini with lemon juice, olive oil, and a touch of maple syrup for a creamy
and tangy salad dressing.
Pasta Sauce: Mix tahini with garlic, soy sauce, and water for a nutty and savory pasta sauce.
Grain Bowls: Drizzle tahini over quinoa or rice bowls for added creaminess and flavor.

Marinades: Use tahini as a base for marinades for chicken, fish, or tofu, adding garlic, lemon, and
spices for depth.

result.

**Sweet Treats:**
Tahini and Honey Spread: Mix tahini with honey or maple syrup for a delicious spread for bread or
pancakes.
Halva: Enjoy tahini-based halva, a traditional Middle Eastern sweet made with sugar and nuts.
Smoothies: Add a spoonful of tahini to your morning smoothie for a creamy texture and a boost of
nutrients.

Topping for Roasted Veggies: Drizzle tahini over roasted cauliflower, sweet potatoes, or carrots.
Sandwich Spread: Replace mayonnaise with tahini in sandwiches or wraps for a healthier alternative.
Burgers: Spread tahini on veggie or beef burgers for an extra layer of flavor.

**Enjoy It Straight**:
With Fruits or Veggies: Use tahini as a dip for apple slices, banana chunks, celery sticks, or
carrots.
Plain: A spoonful of tahini by itself is a quick, energy-boosting snack!

**Natural Taste:** Stone milling preserves the natural, nutty flavor of sesame seeds better than
high-speed industrial grinders, which can generate heat and alter the flavor.
**Enhanced Aroma: **Freshly milled tahini has a rich, robust aroma that is often lost in
mass-produced versions.

01

### Premium Sesame Seeds

We source only the finest sesame seeds, carefully selected for their purity, rich flavour, and high
oil content. Every batch is hand-inspected before grinding.

02

### Traditional Stone-Grinding

Our tahini is slowly stone-ground the traditional way cool temperatures preserve natural oils and
nutrients, delivering a depth of flavour that machine processing can't match.

03

### Small Batch Production

We produce in small batches to guarantee freshness and consistency. Every jar receives our full
attention quality over volume, every single time.

04

### Zero Additives, Ever

Just pure sesame seeds. No added oils, no preservatives, no stabilizers. What you see on the label
is exactly what's in the jar — nothing more, nothing less.

05

### Shipped Fresh to Your Door

Every order is packed and shipped within days of production from our Mississauga facility. You
receive tahini at its freshest — never sitting in a warehouse for months.

The website **cannedfood.it** has been online since 2008 and is an international **B2B directory**
devoted exclusively to the world of canned and preserved food. The platform includes sections
dedicated to canned food manufacturers, importers, products, trade exhibitions, packaging and

category and by country.

### KEY BENEFITS OF CANNING

Canning is a popular method of food preservation that offers several significant advantages:
- **Long Shelf Life**: One of the primary benefits of canning is that it extends the shelf life of
foods. Properly canned foods can last for years without refrigeration, making them a reliable option
for long-term storage.
- **Nutritional Retention**: Canning helps preserve the nutritional value of foods. The process
typically involves heating the food to kill bacteria and enzymes, which helps maintain vitamins and
minerals effectively.
- **Convenience**: Canned foods are incredibly convenient. They are pre-cooked and ready to eat,
which saves time in meal preparation. This is especially beneficial for busy lifestyles or during
emergencies when fresh food may not be available.
- **Reduced Food Waste**: By canning surplus fruits and vegetables, individuals can minimize food
waste. This is particularly useful during harvest seasons when there is an abundance of produce.
- **Cost-Effectiveness**: Canning can be a cost-effective way to preserve seasonal produce. Buying
in bulk when prices are low and canning them for later use can lead to significant savings.
- **Flavor and Variety**: Canned foods can offer a wide variety of flavors and options throughout
the year, regardless of the season. This allows for diverse meal planning and enjoyment of different
foods year-round.

In summary, **canning is an effective method for preserving food that provides long shelf life,
retains nutritional value, offers convenience, reduces waste, and can be cost-effective while
enhancing meal variety**.

In the search for the best solution, for food that is ecologically, but also nutritionally and
healthily acceptable, we find ourselves at a crossroads, where it is important to make a responsible
decision for ourselves and for the environment. Although there have been prejudices about canned
food for years, all research confirms that this mode of consumption has a high ecological value both
in terms of nutritional values and in terms of packaging that meets the three sustainability
requirements: reduce, reuse and recycle. Knowledge and information are the best weapons in the fight
against global and personal problems, so let's start breaking down the prejudices that circulate
when it comes to canned food.
